assignment_statement: Read R and C (1 <= R,C <= 30), followed by an R by C grid whose cells are 0 (open) or 1 (blocked). Count paths from the top-left to the bottom-right using only right and down moves and never entering a blocked cell. If either endpoint is blocked, the answer is zero. Print the path count followed by a newline; it fits in a signed 64-bit integer.

spec_summary: Read R and C (1 <= R,C <= 30), followed by an R by C grid whose cells are 0 (open) or 1 (blocked). Count paths from the top-left to the bottom-right using only right and down moves and never entering a blocked cell. If either endpoint is blocked, the answer is zero. Print the path count followed by a newline; it fits in a signed 64-bit integer.

control_flow_and_data_types: Main function returns 1 on any validation failure.
Main function returns 0 on successful execution.
Uses int for R, C, and grid values.
Uses long long for dp array to prevent overflow.
Loops iterate i from 0 to rows-1 and j from 0 to cols-1.
DP recurrence: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j] + dp[i][j-1] (0 if out of bounds).
Output format: signed 64-bit integer followed by newline.
dropped_contradictory_weak_points: No check if blocked[0][0] is 0 before setting dp[0][0]=1.
No check if blocked[rows-1][cols-1] is 0 before printing result.
No check if grid is fully populated before DP starts.
No check if blocked[i][j] is 0 or 1 for all i,j.
submission_analysis.implementation_summary: The program reads R and C, validates bounds, reads a blocked grid, and computes paths using dynamic programming. It initializes dp[0][0]=1 and iterates to sum paths from top-left to bottom-right, skipping blocked cells. Output is the final dp value.
input_parsing_and_validation: Validates R and C are integers within [1, 30] via scanf return check.
Validates each cell in the grid is 0 or 1 via scanf return check.
Reads blocked grid into a fixed-size array of 30x30.
Does not use the read values after validation.
No bounds check on grid dimensions beyond the main loop limits.
No check if grid is fully populated before DP starts.
No check if blocked[0][0] is 0 before setting dp[0][0]=1.
No check if blocked[rows-1][cols-1] is 0 before printing result.
likely_weak_points: No check if R or C is 0 (though bounds check covers this).
No check if R or C is negative (though bounds check covers this).
recommended_test_dimensions: R=30, C=30, blocked at (0,0) and (29,29) but (1,1) open (expected 0).
